qualification_program.source:
import datetime
import hashlib
import inspect
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

import yaml
from src.integration.ci import IntegrationTrustManifest
from src.integration.models import HierarchicalIntegrationPolicy, HostedCheckPolicy
from src.integration.trust_manifest import canonical_text

source = sys.argv[1]
out = Path(sys.argv[2])
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
checks = []

def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args])

def blob(path, revision=source):
    return git('show', f'{revision}:{path}')

def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()

def check(name, passed, detail):
    checks.append({'name': name, 'result': 'pass' if passed else 'fail', 'detail': detail})
    if not passed:
        raise AssertionError(name)

paths = [
    '.github/agent-queue-integration.json',
    '.github/workflows/tests.yml',
    '.github/workflows/main-attestation.yml',
    'tools/aq_attestation.py',
    'tools/aq_attestation.LICENSE',
    'tools/tests/test_aq_attestation.py',
    'docs/agent/aq-promotion/train-policy.proposal.json',
    'docs/agent/aq-promotion/trust-manifest.draft.json',
    'docs/agent/aq-promotion/hosted-check-policy.json',
    'docs/agent/qa-cookbook.md',
]
files = {}
for path in paths:
    data = blob(path)
    target = out / path
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    target.write_bytes(data)
    files[path] = {'sha256': sha(data), 'git_blob': git('rev-parse', f'{source}:{path}').decode().strip(), 'bytes': len(data)}

manifest = json.loads(blob(paths[0]))
draft = json.loads(blob(paths[7]))
hosted = json.loads(blob(paths[8]))
policy = json.loads(blob(paths[6]))
names = ['Native Windows build and tests', 'Linux foundation build and tests']
expected = {
    'schema': 'aq.integration-trust.v1',
    'canonical_repository_id': 'matter-engine-cpp',
    'repository_id': 1266132968,
    'full_name': 'ElectricJack/matter-engine',
    'ci_producer_app_id': 15368,
    'attestation_app_id': 5075923,
    'attestation_name': 'Agent Queue Integration Attestation',
    'required_checks': {'version': 'matter-engine-ci-v1', 'names': names},
}
base = {key: manifest[key] for key in expected}
base_digest = sha(canonical_text(base).encode('utf-8'))
check('authenticated_generated_identities', base == expected, base)
check('generated_base_canonical_digest', base_digest == '73bf03ce85880f5fb53800cf9ec64b8c494a462c26d9e2cf7b3e4cc0f6d7efe1', base_digest)
check('production_file_digest', files[paths[0]]['sha256'] == '4ba1582f5ef9dc0656d04739034f5891261a05017125fcbb4421adb2667b6f13', files[paths[0]]['sha256'])
check('production_uses_supported_canonical_text', blob(paths[0]) == canonical_text(manifest).encode('utf-8'), 'Sorted keys, two-space indent, one trailing newline')
check('reviewed_extensions_only', set(manifest) == set(expected) | {'promotion_attestation_names', 'check_sets'}, sorted(set(manifest) - set(expected)))
check('promotion_names_match_reviewed_draft', manifest['promotion_attestation_names'] == draft['promotion_attestation_names'] == ['Agent Queue Promotion Attestation (staging)', 'Agent Queue Promotion Attestation (release)'], manifest['promotion_attestation_names'])
check('source_audit_aliases_match_reviewed_policy', manifest['check_sets'] == draft['check_sets'] == hosted['check_sets'] == {'promotion-source-audit': ['unattested-ci / ' + name for name in names]}, manifest['check_sets'])
check('unresolved_draft_app_not_copied', draft['attestation_app_id'] is None and manifest['attestation_app_id'] == 5075923, {'draft_app': draft['attestation_app_id'], 'production_app': manifest['attestation_app_id']})
IntegrationTrustManifest.model_validate_json(blob(paths[0]))
HostedCheckPolicy.model_validate_json(blob(paths[8]))
HierarchicalIntegrationPolicy.model_validate_json(blob(paths[6]))
check('current_supported_schema_validation', True, ['IntegrationTrustManifest', 'HostedCheckPolicy', 'HierarchicalIntegrationPolicy'])
check('reviewed_full_policy_digest', files[paths[6]]['sha256'] == 'cbdf69cdfc043fd929a92e31dbfc192a26127fc4de8c5442d6a565e26a7b69d7', files[paths[6]]['sha256'])
for boundary, artifact, contract, normalized in (
    ('parent', 'a7455b7c3a2d2bdca62365e6d1d7f4ebe158a47aa0db5009812b8294349ddacd', 'a4b6e09f12c8c3111b1987f4d09fd86c45b973a1cc83b9d689f566d4e937b4c0', '7dcad46a111fc4f0c9eae94ca3b57ed44252212c236f934aafa2957e7d4de13c'),
    ('root', '6e28d8dbc4eb93c255813417c6b5d03fdda5bf099dd1be70cf039fb67aa2ed52', '33581303bf8556083f103154d1b94b810df3c398a49c2dbe90bcf68d37697e41', '37a6a9659c6cbe46244f1e45a25987bbe47669399bdf33691f924a16933f41d6'),
):
    value = policy[boundary]
    route = value['route']
    snapshot = route['artifact']
    check(f'{boundary}_reviewed_boundary', value['required_checks'] == {'version': 'matter-engine-ci-v1', 'names': names, 'producer_id': '15368'} and value['admission'] == 'reviewed' and value['authorized_task_ids'] == [] and value['repair']['on_exhausted'] == 'human' and value['repair']['primary_attempts'] == value['repair']['debug_attempts'] == 3, value)
    check(f'{boundary}_reviewed_route_snapshot', route['scope'] == 'system' and route['scope_identifier'] == '' and route['activation_id'] is None and route['playbook_id'] == ('parent-integration' if boundary == 'parent' else 'root-train') and snapshot['artifact_sha256'] == 'sha256:' + artifact and snapshot['contract_fingerprint'] == 'sha256:' + contract and snapshot['source_digest'] == 'sha256:' + normalized and snapshot['schema_generation'] == 2 and snapshot['compiler_build'] == 'playbook-v2-compiler/1' and snapshot['version'] == 1, route)
check('complete_hierarchical_policy_retained', policy['version'] == 1 and policy['branchless_parent'] == 'verifier' and policy['on_failed_child'] == 'block' and policy['on_main_moved'] == 'rebuild' and policy['ci'] == {'source': 'hosted'} and policy['train'] == {'cadence_seconds': 300, 'settling_cap_seconds': 1800} and policy['prerequisite_branches'] == 'wait-for-parent' and policy['cleanup'] == {'max_attempts': 5, 'retry_base_seconds': 30.0, 'retry_max_seconds': 3600.0, 'successful_source_refs': 'delete', 'failed_work_retention_seconds': 604800}, policy)

before = 'a2186ec3f352426c0f79dcd2a24a6745b657ca96^'
workflow = blob(paths[1])
original = blob('.github/workflows/native-windows.yml', before)
check('real_workflow_byte_preserving_rename', workflow == original, {'original_ref': before, 'original_path': '.github/workflows/native-windows.yml', 'original_sha256': sha(original), 'renamed_sha256': sha(workflow)})
check('old_workflow_absent', subprocess.run(['git', 'cat-file', '-e', f'{source}:.github/workflows/native-windows.yml'], stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL).returncode != 0, 'No duplicate or placeholder workflow')
caller = blob(paths[2])
caller_before = blob(paths[2], before)
check('caller_only_updates_reusable_workflow_path', caller == caller_before.replace(b'uses: ./.github/workflows/native-windows.yml', b'uses: ./.github/workflows/tests.yml'), {'previous_sha256': sha(caller_before), 'current_sha256': sha(caller)})
w = yaml.load(workflow, Loader=yaml.BaseLoader)
c = yaml.load(caller, Loader=yaml.BaseLoader)
check('explicit_candidate_and_pr_triggers', w['on']['push']['branches'] == ['aq/**'] and w['on']['pull_request']['branches'] == ['dev', 'staging', 'main'] and w['on']['pull_request']['types'] == ['opened', 'synchronize', 'reopened', 'ready_for_review'] and {'workflow_call', 'workflow_dispatch'} <= set(w['on']), w['on'])
check('real_platform_jobs_and_runner_gates', w['name'] == 'Native Windows' and set(w['jobs']) == {'native', 'linux-foundations'} and w['permissions'] == {'contents': 'read'} and w['jobs']['native']['name'] == names[0] and w['jobs']['native']['runs-on'] == ['self-hosted', 'Windows', 'X64', 'matter-engine-msvc'] and w['jobs']['native']['timeout-minutes'] == '90' and w['jobs']['native']['env'] == {'CMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL': '4', 'CTEST_PARALLEL_LEVEL': '2'} and w['jobs']['linux-foundations']['name'] == names[1] and w['jobs']['linux-foundations']['runs-on'] == 'ubuntu-latest', {'permissions': w['permissions'], 'native': w['jobs']['native'], 'linux': w['jobs']['linux-foundations']})
check('attestation_read_only_and_fallback_preserved', c['on']['push']['branches'] == ['dev', 'staging', 'main'] and c['permissions'] == {'contents': 'read', 'checks': 'read'} and c['jobs']['unattested-ci']['uses'] == './.github/workflows/tests.yml' and c['jobs']['unattested-ci']['if'] == "${{ always() && (needs.attestation.result != 'success' || needs.attestation.outputs.attested != 'true') }}", c)
license_text = blob(paths[4]).decode()
check('verifier_license_and_upstream_attribution', 'MIT License' in license_text and 'Copyright (c) 2026 Jack Kern' in license_text and 'b2bb25872e769cbc5013e8b5a5ea62803fbc721c' in blob(paths[3]).decode() and 'aq_attestation.LICENSE' in blob(paths[3]).decode(), files[paths[4]])
check('qa_recipe_15_present', '## 15.' in blob(paths[9]).decode() and 'promotion' in blob(paths[9]).decode().lower(), files[paths[9]])

schemas = []
for model in (IntegrationTrustManifest, HostedCheckPolicy, HierarchicalIntegrationPolicy):
    module = Path(inspect.getfile(model))
    schemas.append({'model': model.__name__, 'module': str(module), 'module_sha256': sha(module.read_bytes()), 'schema_sha256': sha(json.dumps(model.model_json_schema(), sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')).encode())})
result = {'task_id': 'sound-impact-80.1', 'source_sha': source, 'source_tree': git('rev-parse', source + '^{tree}').decode().strip(), 'checked_at_utc': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'files': files, 'generated_base_canonical_sha256': base_digest, 'checks': checks, 'schema_models': schemas, 'result': 'pass'}
(out / 'qualification.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'source_sha': source, 'result': 'pass', 'checks': len(checks), 'output': str(out / 'qualification.json')}))
